component.name: SROVA
component.summary: Headless audiophile player with bit-perfect output support

description.p: SROVA is a headless audiophile music player for Local Music, TIDAL, and Internet Radio. It is designed for bit-perfect playback, dedicated audio systems, and browser-based control from desktops, tablets, and phones on your local network.
SROVA starts automatically after installation and after each reboot. Use the Open button to view the local and network browser addresses for your running SROVA server.
Features include Local Music library scanning, TIDAL playback, Internet Radio, DAC status, exclusive audio output indicators, and a responsive web interface.

screenshot.caption: SROVA web interface for local, TIDAL, and radio playback

description.p: RC1 packaging update: SROVA now installs as a headless service and the desktop Open action shows the SROVA browser access popup instead of launching a legacy desktop app.
This build includes SROVA branding, support contact metadata, AppStream installer details, and improved side-by-side behavior with older installations.
